audit_items.proof_trace: After every repay operation, `unsafe_repay_debt_only` unconditionally checks `if (!debt.has_debt()) { wit_table::remove(...) }` (lines 189-191). The full-repay branch calls `debt.cleared()` which sets `amount = math::float::zero()`, making `has_debt()` return false and triggering removal. All repay entry points (`repay_debt` and the liquidation path in market.move:774) route through this function, so no zero-debt ghost entry can persist.
